meta.name: Run a Telegram RAG support chatbot with OpenAI, Pinecone, and Google Sheets

name: Telegram AI Support Chatbot with RAG - Text, Voice, Image, PDF + Pinecone + Sheets Log

parameters.content:
## 🤖 Telegram AI Support Chatbot with RAG - Text, Voice, Image, PDF + Pinecone + Sheets Log

A multi-modal AI support chatbot on Telegram. Users send any message type: plain text, voice notes, photos, or PDF documents. The bot converts everything to text, searches your knowledge base in Pinecone using RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and a ChatGPT AI model answers using only that retrieved context, so the bot never makes things up. Every exchange is logged to Google Sheets with a per-user session ID. Works instantly with any Telegram bot token, no business account or approval process needed.

## What each node does
- **1. Telegram Trigger - Receive Messages** receives every incoming message sent to the bot
- **2. Code - Detect Message Type** detects text, voice, photo, document, or the admin /ingest command and extracts the user, chat, and file IDs
- **3. Switch - Route by Message Type** sends each message type to the right processing branch
- **4 to 6. Voice branch** - Telegram gets the voice file URL, HTTP downloads the OGG audio, and OpenAI Whisper transcribes it to text
- **7 to 9. Photo branch** - Telegram gets the photo file URL, HTTP downloads the image, and ChatGPT AI Vision describes it and reads any visible text
- **10 to 12. Document branch** - Telegram gets the document file URL, HTTP downloads the PDF, and Extract From File reads the text
- **13. Code - Build Query Text from Any Input** merges all branches into one final text query
- **14. HTTP - OpenAI Embed Query** turns the query into a vector embedding
- **15. HTTP - Pinecone Vector Search** finds the top 3 matching knowledge chunks
- **16. Code - Build RAG Context from Results** assembles the retrieved chunks into a context block
- **17. HTTP - AI Generate Answer** the ChatGPT AI model writes the final answer using only the knowledge base context
- **18. Code - Format Reply and Prepare Log** trims the reply to the Telegram limit and prepares the log row
- **19. Telegram - Send Reply to User** sends the answer back to the user (parallel branch)
- **20. Sheets - Log Conversation** appends the full exchange to the conversation log (parallel branch)

## Use cases
Customer support bot for a product or service, internal team knowledge base assistant, school or college Q&A bot, restaurant menu and ordering info bot, real estate property info bot.

## Key things to know
1. **Pinecone free tier** - the free Starter plan gives 1 index with 100K vectors, more than enough for most support knowledge bases. One document chunk equals one vector
2. **Voice notes** - Telegram voice notes are OGG format and OpenAI Whisper handles OGG natively, no conversion needed
3. **Session ID** - every user gets a session ID (tg_ plus their user ID) attached to each logged exchange. For true multi-turn memory, store chat history against this session ID or connect an n8n memory node
4. **Admin ingestion** - only the Telegram user whose ID matches YOUR_TELEGRAM_ADMIN_USER_ID can send the /ingest command. This workflow recognizes and acknowledges the command; run your separate ingestion workflow to chunk, embed, and upload documents to Pinecone
5. **PDF size** - PDF text is truncated to 8000 characters before the AI call, so split very large PDFs into sections before uploading

## Google Sheet setup
Create a Google Sheet, add a tab named **Conversations**, and put these column headers in row 1:
Timestamp, User ID, Username, Message Type, User Message, Bot Reply, RAG Chunks Used, Session ID

## Set up steps
1. **Telegram bot** - open Telegram, search @BotFather, send /newbot, follow the steps, and copy the Bot Token. In n8n create a Telegram API credential with this token and connect it to nodes 1, 4, 7, 10, and 19. Also replace `YOUR_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` inside the download URL in nodes 5, 8, and 11
2. **OpenAI** - connect your OpenAI API credential in nodes 6, 9, 14, and 17. Whisper transcription, ChatGPT AI Vision, embeddings, and the answer model all use this one credential
3. **Pinecone** - sign up free at https://pinecone.io and create an index named support-kb with 1536 dimensions and cosine metric. Replace `YOUR_PINECONE_API_KEY` and `YOUR_PINECONE_INDEX_HOST` in node 15 (the host looks like https://support-kb-abc123.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io)
4. **Google Sheets** - create the sheet as described above, connect Google Sheets OAuth2, and replace `YOUR_CONVERSATION_LOG_SHEET_ID` in node 20
5. **Admin ID** - replace `YOUR_TELEGRAM_ADMIN_USER_ID` in node 2 so only you can use the /ingest command
6. **Activate** - activate the workflow, open your Telegram bot, and send a test message in any format

## Message Routing
Telegram Trigger receives every message. Code detects the message type (text, voice, photo, document, or the admin /ingest command) and extracts all user, chat, and file IDs. Switch then routes each type to the right processing branch.

## Media Processing Branches
Voice branch: get the file URL, download the OGG audio, and Whisper transcribes it to text. Photo branch: get the file URL, download the image, and ChatGPT AI Vision describes it and reads any visible text. Document branch: get the file URL, download the PDF, and Extract From File reads the text. All branches converge on the query builder.

## RAG Pipeline
Code merges every input type into one final query. OpenAI embeddings turn the query into a vector, Pinecone returns the top 3 matching knowledge chunks, Code assembles them into a context block, and the ChatGPT AI model writes the final answer using only that context.

## Reply and Log
Code trims the answer to the Telegram 4096 character limit and prepares the log row. Two parallel branches run: Telegram sends the reply back to the user, and Sheets appends the full exchange to the conversation log for audit and analysis.
